engineering.details: Existing constant-area mass-balance and storage-bound model retained unchanged; 3D water level consumes its result.

pedagogy.details: Four steps show governing balance, storage change, boundary behavior, and conservation interpretation.

functionality.details: Source review covers parameter validation, deterministic absolute-time state, reset/snapshot/resize and disposal.

animation.details: Water level and inlet/outlet/overflow tracers directly represent modeled state; demo time acceleration is explicitly disclosed.

spatial3d.details: Real Three.js tank shell, water volume and routing are implemented with camera staging; rendered comparison unavailable.

accessibility.details: Keyboard controls, text steps, numeric HUD and reduced-motion camera behavior implemented; browser/AT verification pending.

visual.details: Surveying-style cinematic scene, restrained overlays and focus mode implemented in source; no fabricated visual pass.

reuse.details: Exact Three.js peer declared; host owns renderer/camera/time; component owns/disposes only its scene group resources.

unresolvedBlockers: Independent WebGL render and surveying-reference visual comparison remain required.
